literal_meaning: পেটে খিদে, মুখে লজ্জা (hunger in the stomach, shame on the face)
figurative_meaning_bn: মনের প্রবল বাসনা লজ্জাবশত প্রকাশ না করা
figurative_meaning_en: Not expressing strong inner desires due to shame
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পেটে খিদে মুখে লাজ নিয়ে চুপচাপ বসে রইল।
গরিব লোকটি পেটে খিদে মুখে লাজ করে সাহায্য চাইতে পারল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He sat quietly with hunger in his belly and shame on his face.
The poor man couldn't ask for help due to hunger in his stomach and shame on his face.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on dignity and restraint in expressing needs.
